description: Carril Preferencial SITP Bogota D C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Corredores arteriales estratégicos ubicados en el costado derecho de algunas vías principales de la ciudad, para el desplazamiento prioritario de los buses del Sistema Integrado de Transporte Público- SITP y que están señalizados sobre el pavimento con el pictograma “CARRIL BUS”. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Its tags are Carril, SITP, bus, calzada, corredor. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2020-02-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
